name: VeriSilicon Microelectronics (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: VeriSilicon Microelectronics (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides platform-based custom silicon and semiconductor IP licensing services in China and internationally. It operates in three segments: One-Stop Chip Customization Services, Semiconductor IP Licensing Services, and Others. The company offers customized silicon services, including high-definition video, high-definition audio and voice, vehicle-mounted entertainment system processors, video surveillance, Internet of Things (IoT) connection, data center, and one-stop chip customized solutions for consumer electronics, automotive electronics, computers and peripherals, industrial, data processing, Internet of …
